criteria.requirement: On-disk SQLCipher ciphertext, wrong-key fail closed, corruption preservation, expired-row and WAL/journal cleanup, and schema version refusal

tests.name: wrong key fails closed and preserves original ciphertext
damaged ciphertext fails without overwriting the file
schema rejects unknown versions without migrating or dropping data
explicit deletion removes owned sidecars and revokes the key
real SQLCipher encrypts on-disk records and excludes raw text
clear revokes session, erases rows and leaves no WAL/journal

criteria.requirement: Memory-only and encrypted on-disk consent, denied operation, session timeout/restart, TTL, duplicate and capacity boundaries

tests.name: observation cannot record without per-session consent and approval
session expiration clears data and requires fresh consent
TTL prunes stale records and refuses future timestamps
capacity, duplicates and immutable snapshots are enforced
TTL purge, capacity and denied writes survive restart
stop and fresh instance never resurrect observation data

criteria.requirement: No plaintext data at rest, network access or implicit re-enablement; Keychain absent => deny without disk write

tests.name: clear purges data without granting consent
key unavailable and no opt-in never create a database

criteria.requirement: Exact-head analyzer, CI tests, encrypted SQLite evidence and reviewer approval
criteria.reason: Flutter analyzer, all named tests and CI are required; a security reviewer must independently verify the exact commit and real macOS Keychain/filesystem behavior before closing. Hosted native-asset tests are automated but are not physical Mac evidence.
